title: Review
description: A structured review of a hypothesis with scored axes and verdict.

hypothesis_id.description: ID of the hypothesis being reviewed.

safety.description: Safety score (1-5). Low scores trigger quarantine review.

goal_alignment.description: Optional. How directly the hypothesis addresses run.yaml's research goal (1-5). Omit when not assessed; consumers treat absence as neutral. Feeds S_goal in composite Elo.

constraint_compliance.description: Optional. Whether the hypothesis satisfies the hard constraints in run.yaml.constraints (1-5). Omit when the run declares no constraints or the axis was not assessed. Feeds S_comp in composite Elo.

key_criticisms.description: List of key criticisms or concerns.

verified_citations.description: Literature record IDs that were independently verified.

phantom_citations.description: Literature record IDs identified as non-existent or fabricated.

citation_manifest.description: Relative path to the immutable citation manifest (e.g. citations/H-0001.json).

contradicting_evidence.description: Literature record IDs of contradicting evidence found during review.

epoch.description: Epoch in which this review was produced.

parent_id.description: Parent hypothesis ID that this variant evolved from.

operator.description: Evolutionary operator applied to create this variant.

criticisms_addressed.description: Prior review criticisms that were addressed in this variant.

criticisms_unaddressed.description: Prior review criticisms that remain unaddressed.

new_weaknesses.description: New weaknesses introduced by the evolution.

net_quality_delta.description: Overall assessment of whether the evolved variant is better than its parent.

recurrent_notes.description: Evaluation of how an evolved variant addresses parent criticisms.
